description: This file defines the GeneralLedgerServices class with methods for creating/updating cost centers and calculating total cost center percentages in an accounting ledger system.

classes.name: GeneralLedgerServices
classes.description: Provides services related to general ledger management, including creating/updating cost centers and calculating total percentages.

methods.name: createUpdateCostCenter
methods.description: Creates or updates cost center entries based on provided account ID and percentage mappings, handling errors and dispatching service calls.

methods.name: calculateCostCenterTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total percentage from a map of category IDs to percentage strings.
